items.title: Admin settings POST must treat an omitted key as 'leave unchanged', not 'set to empty'
items.description: The compose-emitted /admin/settings handler loops over every ALLOWED_KEYS entry and writes `req.body[key] ?? ''`, so any partial or programmatic POST silently blanks every field that is not in the body. Symptom: image URL settings (about photo, hero image) were cleared after a later content sync propagated the blanks. Fix: `if (req.body[key] === undefined) continue;` so an absent key is preserved while an explicit empty-string submit still clears the value on purpose. Same class of bug as the unchecked-checkbox case: omission must never be destructive.
items.notes: Shipped. Regression test lives in compose/tests/test_build_pipeline.py.

items.title: scripts/cas-roadmap-loop.sh: verify git push + gh pr create succeeded before marking in_review
items.description:
BUG: the HIGH-risk PR path in scripts/cas-roadmap-loop.sh (and the analogous fast path) uses `|| true` after `git push origin "$branch"` and `gh pr create`, which silently swallows failures. The loop then marks the roadmap item `status: in_review` and writes a `review: PR created for manual review` heartbeat regardless. Net effect: items show as in_review with an EMPTY commit_sha and no matching auto/* branch on the remote.

FIX: capture the push and PR exit codes and only mark in_review when both succeed. On failure: (a) revert the roadmap item to status=pending with status_drift_note='push_or_pr_failed at <ts>', (b) emit a `failed` heartbeat with detail='Push or PR creation failed', (c) clean up the local branch and worktree. Also use `CAS_EXECUTOR=1 git push` so auto/* branches bypass the staging-workflow block (the fast path already does this).

**STRICT SCOPE: modify ONLY `scripts/cas-roadmap-loop.sh`. Add ONE test file at `tests/test_executor_push_and_pr_verification.py` asserting the script sources cleanly and that the push/PR call sites use captured exit codes (not `|| true`). Do NOT modify CLAUDE.md, docs, brand voice, web/, compose/, or any other file.**

Acceptance: (1) grep for `git push origin "$branch" >> "$log_file" 2>&1 || true` in scripts/cas-roadmap-loop.sh returns 0 matches; (2) shellcheck still passes if available; (3) the new test file asserts the captured-exit-code pattern and revert-on-failure.

items.title: v2: validate http(s): scheme on customer-input URLs before href + src interpolation
items.description: From an audit of an executor commit. Two new widgets interpolate raw customer-input URLs into HTML attributes without scheme validation: (1) compose/widgets/content/video-embed-nocookie.ejs renders `` in its fallback branch for unrecognized video URLs; (2) compose/widgets/content/photo-slideshow.ejs renders ``. EJS `<%= %>` HTML-escapes but does NOT block `javascript:` scheme URLs. The surface is admin-input only, so the blast radius is small (admins attack themselves), but the safer pattern is a one-line guard such as `if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(url)) { skip-or-default }`. Audit ALL widgets for the same pattern (`grep -rn 'href="<%=' compose/widgets/`) and apply the guard consistently.
items.notes: Defense-in-depth security hardening, derived from the same audit.

items.title: v2: prepare compose-emitted inline scripts for CSP nonce mode (tracking the web/src/app.ts nonce-only tightening)
items.description: From an audit of an executor commit. The new compose/widgets/content/photo-slideshow.ejs widget emits an inline `<script>(function() { ... })();</script>` block with NO nonce attribute. Compose-emitted customer apps did not enforce a nonce-based CSP at that point, so it worked, but the CAS public web (web/src/app.ts) has since tightened script-src to nonce-only. If compose-emitted apps adopt the same CSP, every inline script across compose/widgets/ needs a `nonce="<%= cspNonce %>"` attribute, which means the resolver has to thread `cspNonce` through the include locals chain. Needed a decision on (a) whether to adopt the CAS pattern for customer apps and (b) the migration order (audit existing inline scripts; refactor to external files where possible; nonce-stamp the rest).
items.notes: Future-proofing; customer apps were unaffected while their CSP still allowed inline scripts.
items.executor_framing_note: Adopt the CAS-public nonce-based CSP pattern for compose-emitted customer apps. Executor task: (1) audit every inline `<script>` in compose/widgets/ + compose/templates/ and list each one; (2) add a per-request cspNonce middleware to compose/templates/server.js (mirror the web/src/app.ts security-headers middleware); (3) thread `cspNonce` through the EJS include chain so widgets can stamp `nonce="<%= cspNonce %>"`; (4) stamp every inline `<script>` tag; (5) tighten the emitted CSP header to drop `unsafe-inline` from script-src and use `nonce-${cspNonce}` instead. Tests: assert a nonce is present on every inline script and that the CSP header is nonce-only.

items.title: v2 compose newsletter widget input is missing accessible name (WCAG 1.3.1 / 3.3.2)
items.description: Spawned by the static a11y audit of the generated-app archetypes (docs/audits/compose-archetype-a11y-2026-05-27.md, Group A). The `<input type="email">` inside compose/widgets/cta/newsletter-inline.ejs has only a placeholder: no `<label>`, no `aria-label`, no `aria-labelledby`. Screen readers announce only `edit email` with no semantic context, and some assistive tech drops placeholder text once the user starts typing. It hits 4 of 9 archetype default home pages (every archetype whose default home includes the newsletter widget); a single widget fix propagates everywhere. Acceptance criteria: (a) add `aria-label="Email address"` AND wrap the input in a `<label class="sr-only">` (defensive: cheap, and lets a future visible-label promotion be a CSS-class swap); (b) re-run `python3 scripts/generated_app_a11y_scan.py` and confirm `input-missing-label` drops to 0/9 archetypes; (c) update tests/test_generated_app_a11y_scan.py if the audit doc's known-bad list shrinks; (d) update the audit doc to mark this entry complete. Scope: single-file widget edit (compose/widgets/cta/newsletter-inline.ejs).

items.title: Live Playwright + axe-core sweep of all 9 v2 archetype-default apps
items.description: Spawned by the static a11y audit of the generated-app archetypes (docs/audits/compose-archetype-a11y-2026-05-27.md, Live pass, prerequisites). The static pass catches structural and token a11y issues without infra, but cannot see dynamic ARIA-live regions, hover/focus state, composited paper-grain backgrounds, rendered tap-target size, or DOM-runtime Tailwind drift. This item builds the live driver. Prerequisites: (1) a Postgres role with CREATEDB; (2) compose/web/migrate.sql applied per archetype; (3) `node server.js` running per archetype (9 unique ports); (4) `npx playwright install chromium`; (5) `cd web && npm i -D @axe-core/playwright axe-core`. Driver location: web/tests/ui/generated-app-archetype-a11y.spec.ts. Per archetype: visit `/`, `/about`, `/contact`, plus one archetype-flagship route (e.g. `/schedule` for fitness-studio, `/menu` for restaurant-cafe, `/services` for tradesperson-contractor). Inject axe; write raw violations to docs/audits/generated-app-archetype-a11y-<date>-<archetype>.json. Append a 'Live pass, results' section to the audit doc mirroring the static table. Also capture the Lighthouse a11y score in the same pass (one server stand-up covers both). Not executor-eligible: needs a DB, a browser and 9 servers; run it manually or CI-side.
items.notes: Follow-up to the static pass; needs live infra.

items.title: generated-apps-public-seo Sub-1: per-route <title> + <meta description> emitter
items.description: Parent: generated-apps-public-seo (deferred, decomposed). For every public route (auth_required=false) in a v2 compose build, emit a per-route `<title>` (derived from page.title || spec.app_name) and `<meta name="description">` (derived from page.description || spec.description, truncated to ~155 chars). Add to compose/templates/layout-public.ejs as a conditional render based on locals.pageTitle + locals.pageDescription threaded from the route emit. Tests: assert per-route titles differ and meta descriptions are present.
items.notes: Decomposed from parent generated-apps-public-seo. Sub-1 of 4.

items.title: generated-apps-public-seo Sub-2: Open Graph + Twitter Card meta on public pages
items.description: Parent: generated-apps-public-seo (deferred, decomposed). On every public-route page in v2 builds, emit `<meta property="og:title|description|type|url|image">` + `<meta name="twitter:card|title|description|image">`. For the og:image fallback when spec.og_image_url is absent: generate a simple OG card via a server-side SVG rendered as PNG using spec.design.primary_color + spec.app_name (no external API call). Tests: assert OG tags are present on every public route and that URLs are absolute.
items.notes: Decomposed from parent generated-apps-public-seo. Sub-2 of 4.

items.title: Emit a build-time grep audit that warns when widget class= references a utility not in CAS_BASE_STYLES
items.description: Once the known missing utilities are added to CAS_BASE_STYLES, add a defensive audit pass to compose/build.py that (1) greps every emitted view file for `class="..."` strings, (2) extracts every utility class token, (3) checks each against the emitted CSS string, and (4) writes a translation warning to compose-manifest.txt for any token missing from the CSS. Bounded scope: pure-Python grep + set diff. No runtime CSS analysis; the audit is a one-pass linter on emitted files only. Acceptance: a test that introduces a deliberate `class="px-99"` reference (not in the CSS) and asserts the warning fires; a second test asserts no false positives on a clean build.

items.title: Design-overlay mode: serve an exported static HTML design per page
items.description: A customer who exports a polished design as static HTML should be able to drop the HTML and photos into a build and have CAS serve it per page (real URLs, not hash routing) with the admin, database and contact form still wired. Proposed shape: a v2 template family 'design-overlay' that stores the template at views/design/<slug>-template.html, has route handlers stamp is-active and is-current classes, a CSRF token and a ?service= preselect, and serves photos from public/photos/. The family would automate photo path rewriting (relative to /photos/X), hash-href to real-URL substitution, hash-router JS removal, self-hosted font preloads and CSRF token injection.
items.notes: The import was done by hand, one design at a time; the steps are not kept in this repository, and this item would automate them.
